_comment: What shape each image surface crops to. Read by BOTH the renderer (domain/image_crop.py) and the builder's cropper, because a cropper locked to a different ratio than the renderer crops to is worse than no cropper -- the tenant frames a shot and the page silently discards it. Three forms: a NUMBER locks the ratio (the layout demands one -- a circular avatar is not negotiable); a LIST offers the tenant those choices; null means the surface accepts any shape and the crop defines it. "original" in a list means the source's own ratio. THIS TABLE LISTS ONLY SURFACES THAT ARE ACTUALLY WIRED: adding an entry does not make a surface croppable on its own, and a surface listed here but not wired would be a lie the cropper cannot detect. Deliberate exclusions are recorded in plans/IMAGE_CROPPER.md. See that plan for the full design.
